23	 * Builds an owner's {@code customerCode}, formatted {@code <LAST3>-<NNNN>} where LAST3 is
24	 * the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a 4-digit zero-padded
25	 * sequence number (e.g. {@code "SMI-0007"}).

27	@Component
28	public class CustomerCodeGenerator {
29	
30	    /**
31	     * Build the customer code for the given last name and sequence number.
32	     *
33	     * @param lastName the owner's last name; its first three letters (upper-cased) form the prefix
34	     * @param sequence the global sequence number, rendered as a 4-digit zero-padded suffix
35	     * @return the formatted customer code
36	     */
37	    public String generate(String lastName, long sequence) {
38	        String trimmed = lastName.trim();
39	        String prefix = trimmed.substring(0, Math.min(3, trimmed.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
40	        return String.format("%s-%04d", prefix, sequence);

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank"
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.NotBlank @org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.Telephone"
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@jakarta.validation.constraints.Email"
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last
            name and address (i.e. they knowingly share a household). Write-only; never persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Stable code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:

## Summary

I implemented `membershipNumber` as a derived, read-only field formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, where `YY` is the last two digits of the registration-date year.

**Design choice:** `membershipNumber` is derived purely from two fields already on the owner (`customerCode` and `registrationDate`), so it belongs with the existing derived read-only presentation fields `displayName` and `initials` — all computed in `OwnerMapper` at serialization time. This needs no schema change, no new column, and avoids assignment-timing/null issues (both source fields are already set by the time an owner is mapped). It also matches the acceptance test's note that the value is "derived from the owner's own fields, so seed-independent."

**Changes:**
1. `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — added the read-only `membershipNumber` string property to the `Owner` schema (this generates `OwnerDto.membershipNumber`).
2. `OwnerMapper.java` — added a `@Mapping(target = "membershipNumber", expression = "...")` on `toOwnerDto` plus a `formatMembershipNumber(Owner)` default method that formats `"%s-M%02d"` from the customer code and `registrationDate.getYear() % 100`, mirroring the existing `formatDisplayName`/`formatInitials` pattern.
